ios.desc:
Cue is your personal AI assistant for work and life.

Instead of juggling separate apps for tasks, planning, reminders, routines, email, meetings, and follow-ups, Cue brings everything into one assistant that helps you stay on top of your day.

Just type or talk naturally:
• Plan my day around my meetings
• Turn important messages into tasks
• Help me reset my week
• Fit in the gym, groceries, and dinner tonight
• Remind me to follow up tomorrow

Cue turns chaos into clear next steps.

What you can do with Cue:

Plan your day in seconds
Describe what you need to do, and Cue builds a clear, realistic plan.

Stay on top of work and life
Manage tasks, reminders, routines, habits, and personal goals in one place.

Turn messages into action
Connect your tools and turn important items into tasks, follow-ups, and plans.

Work around your calendar and meetings
Use Cue alongside your schedule so tasks fit around your real day.

Get help where work happens
Use Cue across connected inboxes, calendars, and work chat tools.

Replan when life changes
Running late or had a messy day? Cue helps you adjust and keep moving.

Build routines that fit real life
Use habits, programs, journaling, focus sessions, and guided structure to stay consistent.

Get support without overwhelm
Cue gives you structure, guidance, and accountability without the friction of rigid systems.

Why people use Cue:
• One assistant instead of many disconnected apps
• Natural language input by voice or text
• Flexible planning that adapts when life changes
• Clear daily structure without overwhelm
• Helpful support across both work and personal life

Great for busy professionals, students, parents, ADHD minds, and anyone who wants more clarity, structure, and follow-through without switching between a dozen apps.

If you want one assistant to help you plan, organize, and stay on top of everything, Cue is for you.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Cue AI – Create Personalized Mini-Apps Instantly (iOS and Android)

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I've built Cue AI, a personal assistant app that instantly creates personalized routines ("mini-apps") simply from text, voice input, or even photos. My goal was to eliminate the hassle of downloading multiple apps or dealing with long, tedious setup processes.

Examples of what you can quickly create with Cue AI:

-  Snap a photo of your plant, get a personalized watering routine.
-  Instantly generate step-by-step cooking guides with full ingredient lists.
-  Easily organize household chores—reminders for laundry, cleaning, and more.
-  Quickly make custom quizzes, trivia games, or educational flashcards.
-  Specialized sessions for professionals, such as speech therapy exercises.

Cue AI is live and available for free (with premium options) on both iOS and Android. I'd genuinely appreciate your feedback, ideas, and suggestions—especially if you're into productivity, personal development, or simplifying daily life!

Try it out here:  
- [Cue AI for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/cue-ai/id6740705859)  
- [Cue AI for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cueai.app&pli=1)

Would love your thoughts on how it could be improved. Thanks!
